title: knowgov gate report
description: What `python harness/gate_cli.py -f json` prints (task-0007): the gate's verdict for one task of one subject's scenario, its findings on the severity ladder, the threshold, the baseline comparison when one was asked for, and the exit code. Version 2 (task-0048); a change is additive or a new version. From version 1: a finding carries `kind` (key, task, stale, suspect_derived), `ref` (the statement or derived output it is about, null for a key or the task) and `related` (a stale statement's verified or approved successors; the invalidated statements a suspect derived output used); a stale statement on a required key is a finding (info when a verified or approved successor replaces it, major when none does) and a suspect derived output is a blocker, so both count toward --fail-on; `stale` and `suspect_derived` are lists of ids instead of counts; the baseline carries `new_suspect`, and a derived output suspect that the baseline did not hold suspect is a regression. A version-1 report still reads as a baseline, holding no derived output suspect. Added in version 2 (task-0049, additive, so not required: a report from before still validates): `version`, the version loaded, and `change`, --stage 2's change. Added since (task-0071, additive): `superseded_by`, each stale statement a verified or approved successor supersedes, with those successors. Added in version 2 (task-0068, decision-0005, additive): `as_of`, the date review currency was read on, and `lapsed`, the statements on required keys whose review has lapsed by then, each also a finding of kind `lapsed` (major). Added since, without a version change: findings of kind preload (info), when the load recorded pre-load verdicts (task-0064).

task.description: the task class of the subject's [tasks] table

store.description: the store adapter: neo4j or rdflib

loaded.description: true: the gate loaded the scenario into the store first; false (--no-load): it read the store as it was

version.description: the version loaded last (task-0049): v1 for stage 1, the subject's [scenario.stage2] version for --stage 2; with --no-load, the store's latest extraction

artefact.description: the changed artefact, re-ingested as its new version

invalidated.description: every statement R-STALE invalidated, by id, on a required key or not

reverified.description: true (--reverify): the owner's recorded re-verification ran before the gate

derived.description: the earlier governed output registered as derived, from the subject's record; null when the record holds none

stale.description: the invalidated statements on required keys, by id, superseded or not

superseded_by.description: each stale statement that a verified or approved successor supersedes, by id, with the successors' ids (task-0071): a reading of the store, never a stored status; a stale statement missing here still blocks its key

suspect_derived.description: the registered derived outputs that used a statement now invalidated, by id

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the date review currency was read on (--as-of; decision-0005): today by default, the subject's pinned record date with --as-of record

lapsed.description: the statements on required keys whose review lapsed by as_of, by id: each reads validated until a new review (decision-0005)

levels.description: every required key's level; what a later run's --baseline FILE compares with

source.description: record, or the path of the baseline file

new_suspect.description: derived outputs suspect now that the baseline did not hold suspect

kind.description: key: a required key's level or flags; task: the task as a whole; stale: an invalidated statement on a required key; suspect_derived: a derived output that used an invalidated statement; lapsed: a statement on a required key whose review has lapsed (decision-0005), its verifications in related; preload: a document behind the keys whose form the pre-load check left unchecked or found findings in (info, task-0064)

key.description: the required key; null for a finding on the task as a whole or on a derived output

level.description: the key's level; a stale statement's own status (invalidated)

ref.description: the statement (stale, lapsed) or derived output (suspect_derived) by id; null for a key or the task

related.description: stale: the verified or approved successors; suspect_derived: the invalidated statements it used; lapsed: the review verifications that lapsed
